agent.heuristic.name: Heuristic (fast)
agent.heuristic.desc: Greedy, simulates each action; fastest. Default for full runs
agent.modai.name: General AI (recommended, works with mod characters)
agent.modai.desc: Card picks, rest sites and shops use a small network that only looks at generic numbers (cost, damage, block…); plays cards like the Learned AI. Works with any character, same speed as the Learned AI, works on Windows
agent.modai-boss.name: General AI (boss-fight search)
agent.modai-boss.desc: General AI + simulates whole boss fights ahead; 20–40× slower, Linux/macOS only
agent.learned.name: Learned AI
agent.learned.desc: Strong AI + parameters learned from self-play (CMA-ES); no search, same speed as the Strong AI, works on Windows
agent.learned-search.name: Learned AI (with search)
agent.learned-search.desc: Learned parameters + look-ahead search in elite/boss fights; strongest and slowest, Linux/macOS only
agent.learned-boss.name: Learned AI (search in boss fights only)
agent.learned-boss.desc: Learned parameters, simulates whole boss fights ahead; faster than searching everywhere, Linux/macOS only
agent.strong-nosearch.name: Strong AI (no search)
agent.strong-nosearch.desc: Boss-aware card picks and rests; often used for single-card A/B (old baseline)
agent.strong.name: Strong AI (with search)
agent.search.name: Beam search
agent.mentor-full.name: spire-mentor full-run AI (external)
agent.mentor-full.desc: spire-mentor's MCTS plays the fights and its PPO networks pick cards, paths, shops and rests; base-game characters only (mod characters fall back to the Learned AI); about 30–50 s per run
agent.mentor-full-ev.name: spire-mentor full-run AI + events (external, strongest at A10)
agent.mentor-full-ev.desc: Like the previous one, plus PPO also handles events and upgrade/remove/transform/enchant choices (event text is read from your game install at runtime), with 4000 simulations in boss/elite fights; about 50–130 s per run
agent.mentorHint: Build the external spire-mentor yourself, set DECKBENCH_MENTOR_SITE / DECKBENCH_MENTOR_PY and restart (see docs/DEVELOPER.md)
agentc.heuristic.name: Heuristic (fast)
agentc.heuristic.desc: Greedy; doesn't plan for the next turn
agentc.beam.name: Beam search
agentc.beam.desc: Width 4, depth 4; finds combos that need setting up, slow

imp.warn.utf16: File was UTF-16 and was read as text.
imp.warn.bom: File had a UTF-8 BOM, which was ignored.
imp.warn.doubleEncoded: The JSON was wrapped in a string and was unwrapped.
imp.warn.seedFromRng: No top-level seed; used rng.seed (common for in-progress saves).

imp.warn.backup: This is a .backup copy, not the file the game is writing.
imp.warn.liveInProgress: This is an in-progress save. When the run ends the game deletes it and keeps the .run file in history.
